correctness.rationale: On full-step exceedance E_h, F(h) integrates |Delta_h g|^p-|h|^(p+gamma). The p-convex triangle bound produces two half-step positive-part integrals and threshold 2^p*(|h|/2)^(p+gamma)-|h|^(p+gamma)=(2^(-gamma)-1)|h|^(p+gamma). For m positive proportional t_i summing one, Jensen applied to strictly convex t^(gamma+1) (gamma+1<0) yields sum >= m^(-gamma), equality iff equal t_i, and m^(-gamma) strictly increases for integers m>=2. All claims are for this proof mechanism, not optimal global Poincare constants.
